findings.description: The 0:00 establishing shot fixes the lot contents: a white sleeper-cab semi tractor with a long trailer, idling west of the diner. When the man pays and exits (1:43-1:51), the view through the front window shows an entirely different vehicle — a dark-green rigid box truck with a white stripe, cab facing east, parked in a different spot closer to the building — and the man walks to it as his own. The scene is one continuous visit (pre-dawn to sunrise, no time-skip marker), and nothing on-screen shows the first truck leaving or a second arriving, so the established exterior seen through the window is contradicted.
